name: latched-navigation
then: Screen 2 remains blurred; a recheck may be queued.

name: latched-on-task
when: AI returns on_task for every screen.

name: latched-error
then: Error is shown; Screen 2 remains blurred and no new blur is created.

name: per-screen-return
when: Press Return to work on Screen 2.
then: Only Screen 2 fades out over 450 ms; Screen 1 stays blurred.

name: return-grace
given: Return to work just cleared Screen 2.
when: An old AI result arrives within three seconds.
then: Screen 2 stays clear during its grace period.

name: return-reblur
given: Return to work cleared a recently confirmed off-task view.
when: Three seconds pass and the view still matches the local cache.
then: That screen can reblur without waiting for AI.

name: relevance-correction
when: Press This is relevant on Screen 2.
then: Only Screen 2 clears and gets a view-scoped exception for up to two minutes.

name: hold-reset
when: Hold End for nine seconds, then release.
then: Progress resets; session and monitoring continue.

name: hold-complete
when: Complete the continuous ten-second Take a break hold.
then: Session pauses, timer freezes, captures stop and all blur clears.

name: stale-new-blur
when: An off-task result arrives after the assessed window changed or is older than 20 seconds.
then: Do not initiate blur from that stale result; queue reassessment.

name: display-disconnect
then: Remove Screen 2 panels; Screen 1 remains blurred.

name: late-after-end
when: Session ends, then the result arrives.
then: Discard the result; monitoring and overlays stay stopped.

name: refresh-stability
when: A new inference starts, fails or is cancelled.
then: Keep the previous verdict, images and capture time together without collapsing the layout.

name: relevant-chat-inactive-sidebar
given: The task is HCI chatbot coursework; an AI app displays a conversation about evaluating chatbot intent routing.
when: An inactive sidebar thread is titled Dissertation and an unselected tab mentions holiday planning.
then: on_task: inactive labels alone do not establish distraction; do not initiate blur.

name: unrelated-chat-allowed-tool
given: The task is HCI chatbot coursework and the user permits T3 and Cursor as task tools.
when: The open AI conversation discusses planning an unrelated beach holiday, while the HCI coursework thread remains in the sidebar.
then: off_task: identify the unrelated holiday messages; an allowed app and relevant sidebar label do not make the active conversation relevant.

name: visible-unrelated-pane
given: The task is HCI chatbot coursework; a relevant conversation is in the foreground.
when: A separate visible pane or another screen displays an unrelated social feed or unrelated AI conversation.
then: off_task for the screen showing substantive unrelated content, even if it lacks keyboard focus.

name: capture-main-app
given: F Distractions is in front of a browser. Its blur/card panels may also be visible.
then: Include the normal app window and dialogs; exclude only intervention panels, including fading-out ones. Do not reveal content hidden behind the normal app window.

name: historical-preview-not-live-activity
given: The only assessable window is F Distractions showing an old off-task screenshot and reason in its assessment UI.
then: unsure: the historical preview and quoted reason do not prove that unrelated activity is occurring now; do not initiate blur from them.

name: reject-inactive-off-task-evidence
given: The model responds off_task with evidenceSource inactive_navigation, monitoring_ui or unreadable.
then: Reject the response as an error: do not create a new blur and do not dismiss an already locked blur.
